static.title: Static check
static.description: C# reads asmdef files, reflection metadata or IL with Mono.Cecil. Same input, same verdict.

tests.title: Linked tests
tests.runsIn: The stage that owns the test assemblies
tests.description: Hand-written tests carry [Rule("ID")]. The rule passes when at least one test is linked and every linked test passes.

agent.title: Agent review
agent.runsIn: The review stage (headless claude -p, read-only tools)
agent.description: A model reads the subject and returns a structured verdict. Verdicts can change between runs, so agent rules default to advisory.

attached.description: Checked only by hand-written tests that carry [Rule("ID")]. Fails while no test is linked.

agent.review.description: A model reviews the subject against the prompt and returns findings. Read-only: the agent may only read files.

params.name: subject
params.help: files: the globs below. diff: files changed since base. rules: the rulebook. linkedTests: each rule with its linked tests. pictures: acceptance pictures with their bindings.

params.name: prompt
params.help: What to check and what to report. The runner adds the output format.

params.name: model
params.help: Claude model alias. Default sonnet.

params.name: files
params.help: subject files: globs of files to review.

params.name: batchSize
params.help: subject files or diff: files per agent call. Every file is reviewed, in as many batches as needed. Default 40.

params.name: base
params.help: subject diff: the git ref to compare with. Default origin/main.

params.name: pictures
params.help: subject pictures: folder of picture files.

params.name: bindings
params.help: subject pictures: folder of binding files.

params.name: maxTurns
params.help: The most agent turns. Default 30.
